props.content gives layout, headings, grey bars, sticker colour and no writing. story_critical: false is accepted per the packet (no prop sheet before the look bible); the content line is filled so the prop cannot come back empty.

'background_rule: Nothing else on the desk; no readable words except the headings; the stickers carry no digits or letters.'

(a) PROGRAM is 'position: top of each sheet' with a 85%-wide line, while each sheet has 'one round red sticker in the top right corner': the first heading and the sticker compete for the same top band, and nothing says which is above. (b) 'each on one single line filling about 85% of the sheet width (letters about 4% of the sheet height)' cannot hold for 'PROGRAM' (7 characters), 'WEEKLY CALLS' (12) and 'A PROMISE' (9) at one letter height: at 4% of height only the 12-character line reaches about 85%.
'previous_shot: null, carry_over: []' (first frame of the hook shot)

'the left sticker largest, the middle smaller, the right smallest' gives no size, so the model can make them near equal and the 'smallest price' read is lost; and 'filling about 85%' (see P8b) can be read as 'stretch to 85%' or 'at most 85%'.
